notes.title: Update 1.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Heya guys,

I just release patch 1.1 for the game. This will probably be the last patch unless a major bug comes to light. I was intending just to fix some bugs for this (which I did) but I also went ahead and made a couple other changes based on player feedback and reviews- and thank you for those who left a review, it means a lot to me to have people appreciate my work!

***CHANGELOG***

-Fixed 6 bugs in the Random Events system
-Added exit game confirmation
-Fully updated the tutorial
-Updated the credits
-Changed all versions to support 32-bit operating systems
